items.title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.17340v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models are expensive to update through full retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces the cost of adaptation, but repeated adaptation creates a growing pool of task-specific LoRA adapters. This pool complicates adapter selection during inference. Existing routing and encoder-based methods often require retraining when new adapters are added, which limits their use in dynamic settings.
